title: Morgan Stanley shares 24 AI adopter stocks to buy now
excerpt: Morgan Stanley says the market's attention is shifting toward AI-driven efficiency. These 24 stocks are among the top AI adopters, the bank said.
content_html:
AI hyperscalers are under serious scrutiny from investors looking for clues about how they'll monetize their massive infrastructure investments, but they're not the only ones feeling the pressure.

Investors also increasingly want companies downstream from AI to employ the technology to grow profit margins, Morgan Stanley said in a note on Monday.

Given the heightened focus on efficiency and productivity, the bank published a list of 24 stocks that have AI adoption as part of their core to thesis and which the bank rates as "Overweight," or the equivalent of "Buy."

"This group has seen relative net margins expand by 50 basis points in just three months, and its net margin profile now exceeds that of the broader market by nearly 400 basis points," Mike Wilson, Morgan Stanley's chief investment officer, said in the note.

"In our view, it is no coincidence that this is occurring as the market becomes increasingly focused on earnings quality and margin expansion," he continued. "Attention is shifting toward operational efficiency, and AI adoption is a key driver."

Here's the full list of AI adopter stocks that Morgan Stanley is bullish on.

Alphabet

Ticker: GOOGL
Sector: Communication Services
AI role: Enabler/Adopter
Commentary: "We view GOOGL as the leading full-stack AI winner"

Roblox

Ticker: RBLX
Sector: Communication Services
AI role: Enabler/Adopter
Commentary: "In our view, RBLX is one of the clearest AI adoption success stories in SMID Internet, with AI embedded across creation, discovery, safety, and localization."

Meta Platforms

Ticker: META
Sector: Communication Services
AI role: Enabler/Adopter
Commentary: "Management has reported a 30% increase in output per engineer since the start of 2025 driven by agentic coding adoption"

Grindr

Ticker: GRND
Sector: Communication Services
AI role: Adopter
Commentary: "AI is accelerating product development, helping the app add additional experiences (such as relationships) along with launch entirely new segments such as a telehealth business with limited resources."

Amazon

Ticker: AMZN
Sector: Consumer Discretionary
AI role: Enabler/Adopter
Commentary: "AMZN's Retail business is, in our view, an under-appreciated GenAI winner"

Navan

Ticker: NAVN
Sector: Consumer Discretionary
AI role: Enabler/Adopter
Commentary: "Its AI-powered virtual agent Ava handles 55% of all support interactions without human intervention — at CSAT scores exceeding human agents — and has contributed approximately 1,100 basis points of non-GAAP gross margin improvement over two years by replacing human travel agents in COGS."

eBay

Ticker: EBAY
Sector: Consumer Discretionary
AI role: Adopter
Commentary: "We view EBAY as an underappreciated winner as agentic eCommerce scales. We think EBAY's large, unique, and used/C2C-focused inventory differentiates it from other eCommerce platforms and improves its visibility in horizontal agents like Gemini."

JPMorgan Chase

Ticker: JPM
Sector: Financials
AI role: Adopter
Commentary: "The largest US bank has made AI a firm-wide strategic priority, with AI viewed as critical to future success. JPM has the largest technology budget among our US bank coverage at ~$20B in 2026, of which roughly $2.3B is tied directly to AI. The bank has deployed nearly 1,000 AI use cases across functions, with roughly 50 already having 'significant' measurable impact."

SEI Investments

Ticker: SEIC
Sector: Financials
AI role: Adopter
Commentary: "AI is driving positive results by improving scalability, strengthening client service, and expanding its value proposition."

Rocket Companies

Ticker: RKT
Sector: Financials
AI role: Adopter
Commentary: "RKT is deploying AI across the full mortgage value chain. Despite concerns mortgage originators are AI-exposed, we see RKT as a relative beneficiary, particularly when rates decline. RKT is deploying AI across customer acquisition, document processing, underwriting, servicing and refinance recapture."

Blackstone

Ticker: BX
Sector: Financials
AI role: Enabler/Adopter
Commentary: "Within its investment business, Blackstone is leveraging AI to streamline due diligence, analyze proprietary assets, and improve investment decision-making."

Bank of New York Mellon

Ticker: BNY
Sector: Financials
AI role: Adopter
Commentary: "'AI for everyone, everywhere, and everything' mantra encapsules BNY's early, enterprise-wide AI adoption strategy that is showing through in strong operating leverage. All employees use BNY's proprietary AI engine called Eliza, a multiagentic, model-agnostic platform running OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic models."

Bank of America

Ticker: BAC
Sector: Financials
AI role: Adopter
Commentary: "BAC has been an early-mover in AI adoption, leveraging its Erica AI platform across the firm for several years."

Hinge Health

Ticker: HNGE
Sector: Health Care
AI role: Adopter
Commentary: "The adoption of AI tools is key factor helping Hinge Health to scale its business efficiently, keeping its physical therapist and health coach head count relatively flat the past 2 years as revenue doubled."

Omada Health

Ticker: OMDA
Sector: Health Care
AI role: Adopter
Commentary: "Omada is using AI tools to drive productivity, keeping its care team flat the past few years even as the business has doubled. Gross margin has increased by 1500 bps the last 3 years to 68% and we expect continued leverage through AI to lead management to increase its long-term gross margin target of 70%+ at its first Investor Day in September."

Heartflow

Ticker: HTFL
Sector: Health Care
AI role: Enabler/Adopter
Commentary: "Pureplay AI/software. HTFL's platform uses machine learning and advanced computational fluid dynamics to create a personalized 3D model of a patient's coronary arteries and plaque composition based on a single CCTA scan, allowing physicians to make more informed risk-staging and treatment decisions."

Axon Enterprise

Ticker: AXON
Sector: Industrials
AI role: Adopter
Commentary: "AXON is an AI adopter through products such as Draft One, which applies generative AI to report writing, alongside tools that support evidence transcription, policy retrieval and video review."

Johnson Controls

Ticker: JCI
Sector: Industrials
AI role: Enabler/Adopter
Commentary: "HVAC systems can account for 30-40% of a building's energy usage, so efficiency is key, and rising electricity prices only make it more valuable. JCI's investments in AI adoption, such as the Nantum AI acquisition, support an improved digital ecosystem, including advanced analytics and optimization, remote monitoring, and predictive maintenance."

HawkEye 360

Ticker: HAWK
Sector: Industrials
AI role: Adopter
Commentary: "HawkEye employs non-generative AI-based technology to accelerate the processing speeds of new emitter types, complemented by proprietary algorithms acquired through its 2025 purchase of Innovative Signal Analysis (ISA)"

Snowflake

Ticker: SNOW
Sector: Information Technology
AI role: Enabler/Adopter
Commentary: "Snowflake is a two-sided AI story: AI as a revenue driver and AI as an operatingleverage lever."

Palantir Technologies

Ticker: PLTR
Sector: Information Technology
AI role: Enabler/Adopter
Commentary: "Palantir's core value proposition is not selling AI infrastructure — it is deploying AI operationally inside enterprises and governments to drive workflow automation and real-world productivity outcomes, with its forward-deployed engineer model allowing customers to realize early success on GenAI initiatives in a way that, in our view, represents a near-peak relative advantage at this stage of the cycle."

Cadence Design Systems

Ticker: CDNS
Sector: Information Technology
AI role: Enabler/Adopter
Commentary: "Cadence has emerged as the leader in Agentic AI within EDA, building on its AI-powered design optimization tools launched in 2021."

Vistra

Ticker: VST
Sector: Utilities
AI role: Enabler/Adopter
Commentary: "VST is embedding AI solutions throughout its generation fleet to better optimize capacity forecasting, plant reliability (through predictive maintenance and valuesbased maintenance), efficiency, and performance management. Through its Retail business, the company is also deploying AI to manage energy flows in real time, resulting in a more responsive and efficient grid."

NextEra Energy

Ticker: NEE
Sector: Utilities
AI role: Enabler/Adopter
Commentary: "NEE is deploying AI across its operations, including financial analysis, strategic planning, field work intelligence, work scheduling, grid optimization, energy forecasting, customer service, and operations management."

He also writes BI's Where to Invest $10,000 column, and contributes to the First Trade newsletter.Prior to Business Insider, William covered the US economy for Bloomberg News in Washington, DC and contributed to TV tech coverage for CNBC in San Francisco. He has also spent time studying or reporting in France, Germany, and Tunisia.He is based in New York.

content_html_zh:
人工智能超大规模企业正受到投资者的严格审查，寻找有关如何将其大规模基础设施投资货币化的线索，但他们并不是唯一感受到压力的人。

摩根士丹利周一在一份报告中表示，投资者也越来越希望人工智能下游的公司利用该技术来提高利润率。

鉴于对效率和生产力的高度关注，该银行发布了一份包含 24 只股票的清单，这些股票将人工智能应用作为其核心论点的一部分，并且银行将其评级为“增持”或相当于“买入”。

摩根士丹利首席投资官迈克·威尔逊(Mike Wilson)在报告中表示，“该集团的相对净利润率在短短三个月内就增长了50个基点，其净利润率目前超过大盘近400个基点。”

“我们认为，随着市场越来越关注盈利质量和利润率扩张，这种情况的发生并非巧合，”他继续说道。 “注意力正在转向运营效率，人工智能的采用是一个关键驱动因素。”
